scope: Ten-species response-blind butterfly resource-envelope pilot only.
purpose: Select species for an exploratory climate-gap diagnostic using data-quality and identifiability criteria only, not climate-effect size.

required_inputs.trait_resource_descriptors: Exact S1 reconstruction from workflow run 36222306369.
required_inputs.contemporary_host_envelope: WCVP-v13 extant non-doubtful host distributions including introduced ranges, rebuilt from fixed WCVP/HOSTS commits.
required_inputs.butterfly_occurrence_units: Checkpointed GBIF pilot after conservative taxonomic resolution.
required_inputs.sampling_effort_proxy: Other frozen pilot-species GBIF record count in the same WGSRPD3 unit.

host_taxonomy_lower_bound.rule: HOSTS-WCVP resolved host-species count >= LepTraits NumberOfHostplantFamilies
host_taxonomy_lower_bound.interpretation: Necessary lower-bound consistency only; passing does not prove host-record completeness.

contemporary_envelope_overlap.rule: Among WGSRPD3 units with sampled butterfly records, fraction outside the contemporary host-resource envelope <= 0.10
contemporary_envelope_overlap.reason: Large outside-envelope fractions indicate that the reconstructed resource surface is not a defensible opportunity set for that species.

sampling_effort_identifiability.reason: Require both states in locations where other pilot butterflies demonstrate nontrivial GBIF sampling.

occurrence_transport.rule: Per-species occurrence ledger status must equal COMPLETE; PARTIAL_TRANSPORT and REJECTED_GBIF_TAXON_MATCH do not enter the climate pilot.
occurrence_transport.reason: Incomplete transport can convert unqueried deterministic pages into false never-observed resource units.

climate_crossfit_rule.observed_unit_split: Deterministic SHA256 split within species; half train-observed WGSRPD3 units and half held-out eval-observed units.
climate_crossfit_rule.niche_training: Estimate species climate center and scale only from GBIF records mapped to train-observed units.
climate_crossfit_rule.comparison: Within contemporary host-available units meeting the sampling-effort threshold, compare held-out eval-observed units against never-observed host units.
climate_crossfit_rule.primary_descriptive_direction: Never-observed host units have larger climate mismatch to the training niche than held-out eval-observed host units.
climate_crossfit_rule.inference: Exploratory effect-size diagnostic only; no confirmatory p-value.
